test_openai_api_generate_text: test the OpenAIAPI backend with llm.generate_text to run a single text generation query
test_openai_api_cache: test the OpenAIAPI backend with llm.generate_text to verify cache hit on repeated identical queries
test_openai_api_batched: test the OpenAIAPI backend with executing.par_iter to run three batched generate queries in parallel
test_openai_api_chat: test the OpenAIAPI backend with llm.chat to run a multi-turn conversation with system, user, and model messages
test_openai_api_generate_object: test the OpenAIAPI backend with llm.generate_object to generate a pydantic model from a prompt
